notes: Tier 1 (curl) only returns an SPA shell (Laravel+Vue app, not actual Shopify despite the /collections/ URL shape). Used Playwright (Tier 2) to render. Main nav's very first item is 'New' -> /collections/new-arrivals; opened it and confirmed a genuine PLP: title 'Designer Curated Custom Upholstery Furniture', on-page heading 'Shop New Arrivals', description 'Shop our latest designer-curated picks.' Single flat listing (a 'Sort By' control only, no sub-category tabs), so recorded as one row. The page's own GraphQL call (merchandiserBySlug, slug=new-arrivals) returned an availableProducts array of 62 items with 62 unique product ids -- matches the 62 unique /products/ links counted in the fully-scrolled rendered DOM. Checked main nav, mega menus, footer, and /categories for any child New Arrivals structure (e.g. 'Furniture New Arrivals') -- none exists, single undifferentiated listing only. No 'New Collection'/'New Season' style page found anywhere that needed the ambiguous-collection judgment call -- the only 'New'-labelled nav destination is this one PLP. Site's own search (?q=) returns the identical 'FOUND 75,321 ITEMS' result for every query, so not relied on as evidence either way. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow.
